note: The acquisition policy (master plan O-1). It is an open institutional decision: every field that carries a normative choice is 'not_decided', and while 'status' is NOT_DECIDED the policy gate denies every external request. Nothing here is a default to be relied on. To decide: set each 'not_decided' value, give the policy a version, set status to DECIDED and external_acquisition to 'enabled', in a reviewed commit with a decision record.
